I told Dana in #north-team that the agreed seat count for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is **100 seats**.

- **The 261 figure is out of date.** Ilse posted 261 in #north-team on Oct 14, and that same morning she posted in #north-random that the real number is 100 because she had read the wrong line. I checked her message in the channel itself, not just the saved note. Dana is in #north-random, so she can see the correction too.
- **The old number is still showing in #north-team.** My Oct 14 reply there, recording 261, was never updated. I've now replied to Dana in that channel so the right number appears there too.
- **Shared notes still hold both numbers.** The 261 entry wasn't marked as replaced by the 100 one, so anyone reading those notes later could pick up the old figure. I can clear out the 261 entry if you want.

A seat count isn't a money figure, so I could share it with the North team without approval.
